Reading this: lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct is the L2 hit rate the paper's
cache-boundary claim (Section IV-D / VI-D) currently infers from
bandwidth arithmetic. dram__throughput.../lts__throughput... are the
two 'is it bandwidth-bound' checks; sm__warps_active... is achieved
occupancy, unrelated to the cache claim but asked for by Reviewer 2.
